title: REQ · Run stops after MaxRetries failures, marks FAILED and removes the worktree once
summary: Retry exhaustion yields FAILED and a single worktree removal
description: Context: the loop in Runner.run breaks when attempt > MaxRetries, then saves FAILED and calls trees.Remove once. Desired: this is proven for MaxRetries 2 with the removal count asserted. Why: stray worktrees or double removal would corrupt later runs.
acceptance_criteria: Given MaxRetries is 2 and all calls fail, When Run is called, Then agent.calls is 3
Given the same setup, When Run returns, Then the stored status is FAILED, the stored error contains the last error text and trees.removed has exactly one entry equal to WorkRoot/EXEC-1

in_scope: Confirm retry loop and failure cleanup path in runner.go
preserve: Failure path order: Save FAILED then Remove

definition_of_done: Retry loop and cleanup verified unchanged and correct
